crm_notes:
RAG / enterprise search focused on embeddings + reranking for clinical docs (PHI). High-level: indexing scale ~30M clinical notes + scanned PDFs (pre-processed -> 600GB of embeddings), anticipated steady-state query load 350k QPS/month (~12k/day, peaks 2k/hr). Primary constraints: strict PHI controls, private networking, per-request access logging at token & doc-level, and immutable audit trail for delegated access.

Performance targets / ask: p95 end-to-end (ANN + reranker) <200ms for single-query (top-10 rerank), recall@10 >= 0.92 on internal eval set, cost target <$0.001 per clinical-query (aggressive). Want recommendations for quantization (8-bit) and embedding index sharding strategy to hit latency and cost.

Security & compliance: require signed HIPAA BAA, SOC2 Type II, SSO via SAML + IdP integration, KMS/HSM-backed key management, strict retention controls (7 years), ability to route all control-plane telemetry to customer's SIEM. "We cannot expose PHI to any shared multitenant compute" — Director of Data Platforms.

Deployment preference: Redwood Private in customer VPC (option for on-prem air-gapped later). Interested in Dedicated for deterministic throughput during clinic hours; fallback flow for surge to lower-cost quantized variant. Data flow: FHIR exports from Epic -> ingestion pipeline transforms -> Redwood-backed index. Need presigned ingestion support and sample ingest tools.

POC scope (4 weeks): index 2M de-identified notes -> evaluate embeddings+ranks, measure p95 latency, run cost model for full 30M index. Success criteria: R@10 >= 0.9, p95 < 250ms in dedicated cluster for PoC, baseline cost estimate for 30M index within forecast.

Quotes/notes from calls: "If audit shows any gap we won't pass certifying committee" (Head of Compliance). "Tolerance for false positives is low — must surface exact-note matches before fuzzy" (Clinical informaticist).

Decision process: technical eval -> security review -> procurement. Target legal + procurement signoff in Apr 2026. AE pushing for dedicated capacity proposal by next week.
